_doc: Single source of truth for the tcg-art agent orchestration. Switching the Vercel account/scope/project, the board, or the repo later = edit this file only; the scripts read from here.

board._doc: GitHub Projects board the watcher polls and the agent writes. ids from `gh project` / field-create.

vercel._doc: SWAP THIS BLOCK to move to a different Vercel account/scope/project (e.g. a future j0ntz-owned Vercel). scope = the team/account slug from the dashboard URL. bypassSecret = Vercel Protection Bypass for Automation token (set once deployment protection is configured; empty disables the protected-preview drive).

land._doc: How the lander merges PRs from Land-state tasks. mergeMethod: squash | merge | rebase.

agent._doc: What model spawned agents START on (claude --model <value>); a human can still flip a LIVE session per-turn via the RC/desktop picker. Resolution order: the task's Agent Model board field (its option label maps to a CLI string via models{}) -> defaultModel -> no --model flag (the server-side default alias). modelFieldId/modelOptions are only needed to WRITE the field (board.sh model); reads come free from the tick's board snapshot. GOTCHA: editing this field's options via the API recreates all option IDs and clears items' selections, same as Agent Status.
agent._effortDoc: Reasoning effort spawned agents start on (claude --effort <level>). Same resolution as model: the task's Agent Effort board field -> defaultEffort -> no flag. The option label IS the CLI value (low|medium|high|xhigh|max), validated against that set, mirroring Edge's agent_effort.
agent._remoteControlDoc: Which agent stages spawn with --remote-control (viewable/controllable from claude.ai). Every RC spawn adds a session to the claude.ai list and fires one notification, so keep this tight: verify/land agents are short-lived and already transparent via their artifacts (PR review comments, issue run reports, tick.log, tmux attach). [] = no RC anywhere.
